title: Advanced Loot Info Configuration Schema
description: Main configuration file for the AdvancedLootInfo mod (config/ali/ali_common.json).

ResourceLocation.description: A Minecraft Resource Location string, typically formatted as 'namespace:path'.

ResourceLocationOrTag.description: A Minecraft Resource Location, optionally prefixed with '#' to reference a tag instead of a single entry.

Ingredient.description: An ingredient. Can be a single item, a tag, or a list of either.

oneOf.description: A list of valid ingredient options.

IngredientValue.description: A single ingredient option. The accepted form follows vanilla for the given Minecraft version: an object with 'item'/'tag' on older versions, a plain item id or '#tag' string on newer ones.

oneOf.description: A reference to an item tag (e.g., 'minecraft:logs').

LootCategoryType.description: The type of the loot category. Required on Minecraft 1.20.1, where the config is parsed with Gson and this field selects the category class. From 1.21.1 on the config is parsed with codecs, the type follows from the list the category belongs to, and this field is neither written nor read.

LootCategoryDefinition.description: Defines the common properties for all loot categories.

key.description: The unique identifier for this category (e.g., 'ali:plant_loot'). Its display name is translated from 'emi.category.<namespace>.<path>'.

type.description: The category type (e.g., BLOCK, ENTITY). Required on Minecraft 1.20.1, unused from 1.21.1 on.

icon.description: The ID of the item used as the display icon.

hide.description: If true, this category will be hidden from the UI. When set on server, no loot data are sent to client.

catalysts.description: Items that lead to this category - looking one of them up in the recipe viewer shows the category (e.g. Fishing Rod for fishing loot).

allOf.description: Loot category matching blocks by id or tag.

blocks.description: Block ids and block tags ('#namespace:path') this category matches. An empty list matches every block, which makes the category a catch-all.

allOf.description: Loot category matching entity types by id or tag.

entityTypes.description: Entity type ids and entity type tags ('#namespace:path') this category matches. An empty list matches every entity type, which makes the category a catch-all.

allOf.description: Loot categories using regular expression patterns for matching (Gameplay and Trade).

pattern.description: An array of regular expressions (regex) used to match loot table Resource Locations.

configVersion.description: Format version of this file. When it is lower than the version the mod expects, the file is renamed to '.bak' and regenerated with defaults.

blockCategories.description: List of loot categories for blocks. The first matching category wins, so catch-all categories must come last.

entityCategories.description: List of loot categories for entities (mobs). The first matching category wins, so catch-all categories must come last.

gameplayCategories.description: List of loot categories associated with gameplay mechanics (e.g., fishing, chest loot). The first matching category wins, so catch-all categories must come last.

tradeCategories.description: List of loot categories associated with trading. The first matching category wins, so catch-all categories must come last.

disabledEntities.description: List of entities that will not be used for gathering loot tables.

tooltipColors.description: Colors used when rendering tooltips. Changes take effect on restart.

text.description: Color of tooltip keys and labels. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

value.description: Color of tooltip values. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

error.description: Color of values belonging to an errored tooltip entry. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

branch.description: Color of the tree branch arrows. A vanilla color name or a hex color code such as #FFAA00. An invalid value falls back to the default.

logMoreStatistics.description: If true, logs more detailed statistics.

showInGameNames.description: If true, displays translated names instead of ids.

hideDefaultBlockLoot.description: If true, hides loot tables of blocks that only drop themselves (vanilla dropSelf), unless a global loot modifier or fake loot table adds something to them.

defaultBlockLootConditions.description: Loot condition types that do not stop a block loot table from being treated as a default drop by hideDefaultBlockLoot. Defaults to minecraft:survives_explosion.

defaultBlockLootFunctions.description: Loot function types that do not stop a block loot table from being treated as a default drop by hideDefaultBlockLoot. Defaults to minecraft:explosion_decay.

ignoredPredicateConditions.description: Loot condition types that do not mark an item as having predicates, so its slot is not highlighted. Defaults to minecraft:random_chance, minecraft:table_bonus, minecraft:survives_explosion and the version's random-chance-with-bonus condition (minecraft:random_chance_with_looting on 1.20.1, minecraft:random_chance_with_enchanted_bonus on newer versions).

entityLootTables.description: Loot tables an entity drops, keyed by entity type id. Only needed for entities whose loot table is neither their type's default one (entities/<entity id>) nor a path below it - those are recognized automatically. Takes precedence over the automatic mapping.
